newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's MFB takes up $60 mln seven-year loan.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's MFB takes up $60 mln seven-year loan.

text.p: Hungary's state owned development bank Magyar Fejlesztesi Bank Rt signed a $60 million seven-year loan facility agreement with a consortium of banks, MFB said in a statement on Friday.

"The transaction creates a benchmark for commercial and merchant banks in Hungary, being the first ever loan agreement in favour of a Hungarian borrower, besides the National Bank of Hungary, with a maturity of seven years," it said.
The margin to be applied is 0.20 percent per annum above the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) until the fifth year and 0.25 percent per annum in the sixth and seventh year, it said.
The syndication was arranged by Bangesellschaft Berlin AG, The Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd, and Dresdner Bank Luxembourg S.A, it said. Seven German and Austrian banks joined the lending consortium.
